test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having alphabets ‘A’ to ‘F’. Find the alphabet on the face opposite the face showing ‘E’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a2d4d1fc4d1c06f3f9923708700f3808e3cfe1965c245933d5d74c148f2a7a0.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/891e06dbbda54faa8601a371005d85ad8fcedb690ee7e6e60fe55f97c0d5336f.png] 

As C and F are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces are opposite to each other.

Clearly, B is the alphabet on the face opposite the face showing ‘E’.
